categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in intelligent terminals, communication modules and industry application solutions, and operation services. Key products include smart set-top boxes, ONU smart home gateways, integrated smart home gateways, smart routers, smart cameras, HarmonyOS terminals, NB-IoT modules, LTE and 5G RedCap communication modules, optical modules, smart city data platforms, information security products, new energy products, smart robots, smart meters, energy storage PACK batteries, FTTR, WiFi7 routers, and photovoltaic projects. The company also focuses on emerging areas such as HarmonyOS ecosystem products, smart city platforms, new energy systems, and intelligent manufacturing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed 11 core general technologies and 16 proprietary core technologies covering multiple business areas, including embedded software development compatible with Android, Linux, and HarmonyOS, digital TV protocol stack technology, WiFi wireless LAN technology, PON access network technology, IoT system integration, NB-IoT and 4G/5G cellular communication technologies, high-speed optical signal transmission, and commercial secret security protection. It also emphasizes intelligent manufacturing with automated production lines, ROM auto-burning, vision-based robotic motion control, automated product testing, and MES systems. The company holds numerous patents and software copyrights and has passed CMMI certification.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company mainly serves telecommunications operators including China Mobile, China Telecom, China Unicom, and China Broadcasting Network. Its products are customized for operator markets and also sold through offline and e-commerce channels under its own brand. Key end markets include digital home entertainment, smart home networking, IoT applications in smart metering, smart cities, shared economy, security monitoring, smart finance, public network intercom, smart wearables, and smart energy. The company is expanding into overseas markets, especially in the Asia-Pacific region.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and major production facilities in Huizhou, Guangdong Province. It has subsidiaries and branches in Beijing, Shanghai, Tianjin, Zhengzhou, and overseas entities in Hong Kong and Singapore. The domestic market accounts for the majority of revenue, with international sales mainly in Asia-Pacific. The company is actively expanding its global footprint leveraging China's leading position in digital home and communication technologies.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on research, development, manufacturing, and sales of intelligent terminals and communication modules. It integrates upstream components such as chips and optical modules sourced from suppliers but emphasizes in-house R&D and intelligent manufacturing capabilities. The company also provides operation services and solutions, positioning itself as a comprehensive digital home and IoT communication solution provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding digital home networking and multimedia entertainment devices, accelerating 5G and IoT product development, promoting HarmonyOS ecosystem products, advancing smart city platforms, developing new energy storage and systems aligned with national carbon neutrality goals, and enhancing intelligent manufacturing capabilities. The company invests heavily in R&D, focusing on 5G RedCap modules, WiFi7 routers, FTTR solutions, AI-enabled smart robots, and secure information technology products. It actively participates in international and national standards development and holds over 450 patents and software copyrights.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of intelligent terminals, communication modules, and industry application solutions. The company also earns income from operation services including smart city projects, smart energy photovoltaic projects, and technical support and maintenance services. Sales are mainly to telecommunications operators via customized contracts and tenders, supplemented by direct sales through offline and online channels. Licensing and software development related to HarmonyOS and IoT platforms contribute to revenue as well.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in the intelligent terminal and digital home networking market, holding significant market share in operator procurement, especially with China Mobile. It is recognized as a technology leader with strong R&D and manufacturing capabilities. The company faces competition in a mature and competitive market with pricing pressure but leverages its early mover advantage, comprehensive product portfolio, and strategic partnerships with chip suppliers and operators. It is also expanding into emerging sectors like HarmonyOS products, smart cities, and new energy to diversify its competitive positioning.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.51 billion, a 15.54% increase year-over-year. Despite a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB -141.8 million, the loss narrowed compared to the previous year. The company’s total assets grew by 23.48% to about RMB 3.69 billion. R&D investment accounted for 6.92% of revenue. The company maintains a solid asset base with net assets of RMB 926 million. Cash flow from operating activities turned positive to RMB 79.3 million, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes technology innovation, product quality, and comprehensive service capabilities as its core value propositions. It offers advanced intelligent terminals with high integration, supporting cutting-edge standards like WiFi7, 5G RedCap, and HarmonyOS, enabling superior user experience in digital home entertainment and smart networking. Its products feature high performance, energy efficiency, and security, with strong customization for operator needs. The company’s intelligent manufacturing and supply chain integration ensure cost-effectiveness and quality control. Its strategic focus on emerging technologies and ecosystems like HarmonyOS and smart cities differentiates it in the market.
